LIMIT 501

WITH "totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, "y".customerid, SUM("y".consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401' GROUP BY "c".segment, "y".customerid), "winners" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (segment) segment, customerid, total_consumption FROM "totals" ORDER BY segment ASC, total_consumption ASC, customerid ASC), "chosen" AS (SELECT MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') AS "sme", MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS "lam", MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS "kam" FROM "winners") SELECT ROUND((sme - lam)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "SME minus LAM", ROUND((lam - kam)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "LAM minus KAM", ROUND((kam - sme)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "KAM minus SME" FROM "chosen" LIMIT 501

WITH "annual" AS (SELECT "c".segment, SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201301') AS "consumption_2012", SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401') AS "consumption_2013" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "y".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') GROUP BY "c".segment), "changes" AS (SELECT segment, (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2012 AS "increase_pct" FROM "annual") SELECT segment, ROUND(increase_pct::NUMERIC, 2) AS "increase_percentage" FROM "changes" WHERE increase_pct = (SELECT MAX(increase_pct) FROM "changes") OR increase_pct = (SELECT MIN(increase_pct) FROM "changes") ORDER BY increase_pct DESC LIMIT 501

WITH "target" AS (SELECT customerid FROM "transactions_1k" WHERE date = DATE '2012-08-25' AND price = 634.8), "annual" AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201301' THEN "y".consumption ELSE 0 END) AS "total_2012", SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401' THEN "y".consumption ELSE 0 END) AS "total_2013" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "target" AS "t" ON "t".customerid = "y".customerid) SELECT ROUND(((total_2013 - total_2012) / total_2012)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "relative_change" FROM "annual" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".customerid) AS "count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y2012" ON "y2012".customerid = "c".customerid INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y2013" ON "y2013".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "y2012".date >= '201201' AND "y2012".date <= '201212' AND "y2013".date >= '201301' AND "y2013".date <= '201312' AND "y2012".consumption > 0 AND "y2013".consumption > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM (SELECT "y".customerid, SUM("y".consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" WHERE "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201301' GROUP BY "y".customerid HAVING SUM("y".consumption) < 30000) AS "annual" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "annual".customerid INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT customerid FROM "transactions_1k" WHERE date >= DATE '2012-01-01' AND date < DATE '2013-01-01') AS "active" ON "active".customerid = "annual".customerid GROUP BY "c".segment LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(DISTINCT "y".customerid) AS "customers" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401' AND "y".consumption > 0 GROUP BY "c".segment ORDER BY "c".segment ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(consumption)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_monthly_fuel_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE customerid = 15621 AND "date" LIKE '2013%' AND consumption > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "c".currency = 'CZK' THEN "y".consumption END) - AVG(CASE WHEN "c".currency = 'EUR' THEN "y".consumption END)) AS "difference" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "y".customerid WHERE "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201301' AND "y".consumption IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM (SELECT "y".customerid FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "y".customerid WHERE "c".segment = 'KAM' AND "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401' GROUP BY "y".customerid HAVING SUM("y".consumption) > 1000000) AS "qualifying_customers" LIMIT 501

WITH "borrowing" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opening_date", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".date), "counterparties" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "t".account) FILTER (WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL) AS "outside_counterparties" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".account_id), "owners" AS (SELECT "d".account_id, "c".district_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER') SELECT "b".account_id, "b".opening_date, "b".total_borrowed, COALESCE("cp".outside_counterparties, 0) AS "outside_counterparties", "hd".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "hd".a8 AS "district_population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "hd".a8 DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "borrowing" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "counterparties" AS "cp" ON "cp".account_id = "b".account_id INNER JOIN "owners" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "b".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "hd" ON "hd".district_id = "o".district_id ORDER BY "hd".a8 DESC, "b".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".gender, "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a13 AS "urban_ratio" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "cd" ON "ca".disp_id = "cd".disp_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "od" ON "od".account_id = "cd".account_id AND "od".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "od".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "od".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS "avg_balance" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "ta" ON "ta".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold' AND "ta".avg_balance > 1000 AND "d".a4::BIGINT > 100000), "stats" AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", MAX(inhabitants) AS "max_inhabitants", ROUND(AVG(salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_salary", ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_urban_ratio" FROM "eligible_districts" GROUP BY gender) SELECT CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' WHEN 'M' THEN 'men' END AS "gender", "s".district_count, "e".district_id, "e".inhabitants, "s".avg_salary, "s".avg_urban_ratio FROM "stats" AS "s" INNER JOIN "eligible_districts" AS "e" ON "e".gender = "s".gender AND "e".inhabitants = "s".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC, "e".district_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "owner_disp".disp_id AND "c".type = 'gold' WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 250000), "pair_totals" AS (SELECT "t".bank, "t".account AS "counter_account", COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" ON "ea".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account), "ranked" AS (SELECT pair_totals.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS "amount_rank" FROM "pair_totals") SELECT bank, counter_account, outgoing_payment_count, total_amount FROM "ranked" WHERE amount_rank = 1 ORDER BY bank ASC, counter_account ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_clients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".client_id, "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "dp".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "dp".type = 'OWNER'), "eligible_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "q".district_id, "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a8 AS "inhabitants", "d".a12 AS "unemployment_1996", "d".a14 AS "average_salary" FROM "qualifying_clients" AS "q" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "q".district_id), "region_averages" AS (SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(average_salary::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG(unemployment_1996::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_1996_unemployment_rate" FROM "eligible_districts" GROUP BY region), "ranked_districts" AS (SELECT region, district_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC) AS "rn" FROM "eligible_districts") SELECT "ra".region, "ra".average_district_salary, "ra".average_1996_unemployment_rate, "rd".district_name AS "most_populous_district" FROM "region_averages" AS "ra" INNER JOIN "ranked_districts" AS "rd" ON "rd".region = "ra".region AND "rd".rn = 1 ORDER BY "ra".region ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "card_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ca"."type" AS "card_type", "cl".district_id, "d".a2 AS "home_district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id) SELECT card_type, home_district, inhabitants FROM (SELECT card_type, home_district, inhabitants, MIN(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY card_type) AS "min_inhabitants" FROM "card_districts") AS "ranked" WHERE inhabitants = min_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, home_district ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_region" AS (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'), "account_balances" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "a".account_id, "latest".balance AS "end_balance" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date <= DATE '1996-12-31' ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "latest" ON TRUE WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' AND "d".a3 = (SELECT a3 FROM "target_region")), "district_averages" AS (SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", ROUND(AVG("ab".end_balance), 2) AS "average_balance" FROM "account_balances" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ab".district_id GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2) SELECT district_name, average_balance AS "highest_average_end_of_1996_balance" FROM "district_averages" ORDER BY average_balance DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".amount, "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "average_salary", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "loan_rank" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "top_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT district_id, inhabitants, average_salary FROM "ranked_loans" WHERE loan_rank <= 10), "population_ranked" AS (SELECT district_id, inhabitants, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC) AS "population_rank" FROM "top_districts" GROUP BY district_id, inhabitants) SELECT district_id, inhabitants, ROUND((SELECT AVG(average_salary)::NUMERIC FROM "top_districts"), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "population_ranked" WHERE population_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

WITH "district_withdrawals" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "a".district_id), "district_accounts" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "account" GROUP BY district_id), "district_orders" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, COALESCE(SUM("o".amount), 0) AS "total_order_debit" FROM "account" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "a".district_id), "qualifying" AS (SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", "dw".total_withdrawn, "dw".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / "d".a4::NUMERIC AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", "dor".total_order_debit::NUMERIC / "da".account_count AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "district_withdrawals" AS "dw" ON "dw".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "district_accounts" AS "da" ON "da".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "district_orders" AS "dor" ON "dor".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000) SELECT district_name, region, population, total_withdrawn, ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS "rank", ROUND(average_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "qualifying" ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "accessible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "a".frequency, "a".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a12 AS "average_salary", "c".district_id AS "home_district_id" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "x" ON "x".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "x".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".client_id = 3541), "tx" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id), "region_clients" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "clients_in_region" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "ranked" AS (SELECT district_id, a3, a2, a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "population_rank", FIRST_VALUE(a2) OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "most_populous_district", FIRST_VALUE(a4::BIGINT) OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "most_populous_inhabitants" FROM "district") SELECT "ac".account_id, "ac".opened_date, "ac".frequency, "ac".district_name, "ac".region, CASE WHEN "ac".district_id = "ac".home_district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "home_district", "ac".average_salary, COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("tx".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("tx".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("tx".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("tx".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("tx".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", "rc".clients_in_region, "rk".most_populous_district, "rk".most_populous_inhabitants, "rk".population_rank FROM "accessible" AS "ac" LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "ac".account_id LEFT JOIN "tx" ON "tx".account_id = "ac".account_id INNER JOIN "region_clients" AS "rc" ON "rc".region = "ac".region INNER JOIN "ranked" AS "rk" ON "rk".district_id = "ac".district_id ORDER BY COALESCE("tx".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "ac".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY') AS "year", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", COALESCE(SUM("account_lent".total_lent), 0) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG("district_rates".amount_lent_per_account), 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "total_lent" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "account_lent" ON "a".account_id = "account_lent".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "a2".district_id, SUM(COALESCE("account_lent2".total_lent, 0))::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "amount_lent_per_account" FROM "account" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d2" ON "a2".district_id = "d2".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "total_lent" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "account_lent2" ON "a2".account_id = "account_lent2".account_id WHERE "d2".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a2".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY "a2".district_id) AS "district_rates" ON "a".district_id = "district_rates".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY') ORDER BY "year" ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".date FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "ranked" AS (SELECT e.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "e".amount DESC, "e".date ASC, "e".loan_id ASC) AS "loan_rank" FROM "eligible" AS "e") SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "r".amount AS "approved_amount", "r".date AS "approval_date", "latest".balance AS "account_balance_at_approval" FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "r".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "r".account_id AND "t".date = "r".date ORDER BY "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "latest" ON TRUE WHERE "r".loan_rank <= 10 ORDER BY "r".amount DESC, "r".date ASC, "r".loan_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "loan_totals" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", SUM(amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id), "card_clients" AS (SELECT "cl".client_id, "cl".gender, "cl".birth_date, "c".type AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "cl".birth_date)::INTEGER AS "age_at_issue", COALESCE("lt".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", COALESCE("lt".total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary" FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "c".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan_totals" AS "lt" ON "lt".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "c".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "c".issued < DATE '1995-01-01') SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, card_type, age_at_issue, loan_count, total_amount_borrowed, CASE WHEN loan_count > 0 AND age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN loan_count > 0 AND age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", district_name, district_average_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY age_at_issue ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "card_clients" ORDER BY client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol IS NULL GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM "loan" WHERE date = DATE '1996-01-03' AND loan_id = 98832) AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "k_symbol" = 'UROK' THEN "amount" WHEN "k_symbol" = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"amount" END) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" WHERE "account_id" = (SELECT "account_id" FROM "disp" WHERE "client_id" = 2823) AND "date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "k_symbol" IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".account_id FROM "loan" AS "l" WHERE "l".duration > 24 AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants" FROM "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "qa".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id), "region_summary" AS (SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS "qualifying_district_count", SUM(inhabitants) AS "combined_population" FROM "qualifying_districts" GROUP BY region), "qualifying_region" AS (SELECT region FROM "region_summary" ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "rs".region, "rs".qualifying_district_count, "rs".combined_population, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "qa".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = "rs".region) AS "qualifying_account_count" FROM "region_summary" AS "rs" INNER JOIN "qualifying_region" AS "qr" ON "qr".region = "rs".region LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "monthly_statement_accounts_opened", COUNT(DISTINCT "d".district_id) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("d".a11::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "c".client_id IS NOT NULL AND "ca".card_id IS NOT NULL THEN "c".client_id END) AS "classic_card_holding_owners", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "ca".card_id IS NOT NULL AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL THEN ("t".bank, "t".account) END) AS "external_accounts_paid", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "ca".card_id IS NOT NULL AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".account_id = "a".account_id AND "p".type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "p".client_id LEFT JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "p".disp_id AND "ca".type = 'classic' LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a13::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1930-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "client" WHERE gender = 'F' AND birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "c" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC(20, 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".amount < 100000 AND "l".status = 'C' LIMIT 501

SELECT "cohorts".cohort, ROUND(AVG("cohorts".salary)) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young cohort' WHEN "c".birth_date <= DATE '1919-12-31' THEN 'old cohort' END AS "cohort", "d".a11 AS "salary", CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS "cohort_order" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' OR "c".birth_date <= DATE '1919-12-31') AS "cohorts" GROUP BY "cohorts".cohort, "cohorts".cohort_order ORDER BY "cohorts".cohort_order ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((("r853".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC - "r854".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC) / "r854".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC) * 100, 2) AS "percentage_higher" FROM "results" AS "r853" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r854" ON "r853".driverid = "r854".driverid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r853".driverid WHERE "d".forename = 'Paul' AND "d".surname = 'di Resta' AND "r853".raceid = 853 AND "r854".raceid = 854 AND "r853".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND "r854".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".positiontext <> '1') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage_not_victories" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Lewis' AND "d".surname = 'Hamilton' AND "ra".year >= 2010 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, MAX("ds".points) AS "highest_recorded_driver_standings_points" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid INNER JOIN "driverstandings" AS "ds" ON "ds".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND((("last_finisher".milliseconds - "winner".milliseconds)::NUMERIC / "last_finisher".milliseconds) * 100, 2) AS "percentage_shorter" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "last_finisher" ON "last_finisher".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1988 AND "r".name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND "winner".position = 1 AND "last_finisher".positionorder = (SELECT MAX("res".positionorder) FROM "results" AS "res" WHERE "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND "res".position IS NOT NULL AND "res".laps = (SELECT MAX("res2".laps) FROM "results" AS "res2" WHERE "res2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res2".position IS NOT NULL)) AND "last_finisher".milliseconds IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "res".laps = "winner".laps) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "res".raceid AND "winner".position = 1 WHERE "d".nationality = 'Japanese' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009 LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, ROUND(AVG("res".milliseconds)::NUMERIC / 1000, 2) AS "mean_winner_elapsed_time_seconds" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year < 1975 AND "res".position = 1 AND "res".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".dob < DATE '1985-01-01' AND "res".laps > 50) / COUNT(*) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "ra".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MAX("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 1995 AND "r2".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q1) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(BTRIM("q".q1), '') IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 1995 AND "r2".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(BTRIM("q2".q1), '') IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "r".time, "d".url FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix' AND "res".position = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> '' AND ("q".q3 IS NULL OR BTRIM("q".q3) = '') LIMIT 501

WITH "french_editions" AS (SELECT "r".raceid, "r".date FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".year >= 1990 AND "c".country = 'France'), "driver_fastest" AS (SELECT "fe".raceid, "fe".date, "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, MIN("lt".milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "french_editions" AS "fe" INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "lt" ON "lt".raceid = "fe".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "lt".driverid WHERE "lt".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "fe".raceid, "fe".date, "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname), "qualifying_rows" AS (SELECT raceid, date, driverid, forename, surname, fastest_ms FROM "driver_fastest" WHERE fastest_ms >= 90000 UNION ALL SELECT "fe".raceid, "fe".date, NULL::BIGINT, NULL::TEXT, NULL::TEXT, NULL::BIGINT FROM "french_editions" AS "fe" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "driver_fastest" AS "df" WHERE "df".raceid = "fe".raceid AND "df".fastest_ms >= 90000)) SELECT date, forename, surname, CASE WHEN fastest_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (fastest_ms / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || CASE WHEN (fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || ((fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000)::TEXT || '.' || CASE WHEN fastest_ms % 1000 < 100 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN fastest_ms % 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || (fastest_ms % 1000)::TEXT END AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "qualifying_rows" ORDER BY date ASC, surname ASC NULLS LAST, forename ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 AS "fastest_q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND btrim("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND btrim("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_full_name", "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year AS "race_year", "q".q3 AS "q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "d".dob) > 1980 AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT "q2".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'British' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "d2".dob) > 1980 AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '' AND POSITION(':' IN "q2".q3) > 0 ORDER BY SPLIT_PART("q2".q3, ':', 1)::INTEGER ASC, SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART("q2".q3, ':', 2), '.', 1)::INTEGER ASC, SPLIT_PART("q2".q3, '.', 2)::INTEGER ASC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, COUNT(*) AS "total_pit_stops" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19) AS "eligible" ON "eligible".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "runner".milliseconds - "winner".milliseconds AS "time_gap_milliseconds" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "r".raceid AND "winner".position = 1 INNER JOIN "results" AS "runner" ON "runner".raceid = "r".raceid AND "runner".position = 2 WHERE "r".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND "r".time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "r".time ASC, "r".year DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time <= '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND (SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) < 98.000 LIMIT 501

WITH "race_times" AS (SELECT "c".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL), "extremes" AS (SELECT MIN(start_time) AS "earliest_time", MAX(start_time) AS "latest_time" FROM "race_times") SELECT (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "rt".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "rt".circuitref ASC) FROM "race_times" AS "rt" WHERE "rt".start_time = "e".earliest_time) AS "earliest_circuitref", (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "rt".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "rt".circuitref ASC) FROM "race_times" AS "rt" WHERE "rt".start_time = "e".latest_time) AS "latest_circuitref", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("e".latest_time - "e".earliest_time))::BIGINT AS "gap_seconds" FROM "extremes" AS "e" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("r".fastestlapspeed) <> '' ORDER BY "r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND ("q".q2 IS NULL OR BTRIM("q".q2) = '') ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid) FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "res".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "st" ON "res".statusid = "st".statusid WHERE "ra".year = 1962 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "st".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "res".position IS NOT NULL)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "res".raceid = "ra".raceid WHERE "ra".year = 1957 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "event_total" FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "x".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND "x".expense_date LIKE '2019-09-%' OR "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND "x".expense_date LIKE '2019-10-%' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "per_event" LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("e"."event_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 2019 THEN "b"."spent" END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("e"."event_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 2020 THEN "b"."spent" END), 0) AS "total_spent_2019_minus_2020" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b"."link_to_event" = "e"."event_id" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("e"."event_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) IN (2019, 2020) LIMIT 501
SELECT "notes" FROM "income" WHERE "source" = 'Fundraising' AND "date_received" = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT "kickoff".amount::NUMERIC / NULLIF("october".amount, 0) AS "ratio" FROM "budget" AS "kickoff" INNER JOIN "event" AS "kickoff_event" ON "kickoff".link_to_event = "kickoff_event".event_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "october" ON "october".category = "kickoff".category INNER JOIN "event" AS "october_event" ON "october".link_to_event = "october_event".event_id WHERE "kickoff".category = 'Advertisement' AND "kickoff_event".event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' AND "october_event".event_name = 'October Meeting' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING SUM("b".spent) / NULLIF(SUM("b".amount), 0) = (SELECT MAX(ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM("b2".spent) / NULLIF(SUM("b2".amount), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b2" ON "b2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e2".event_id) AS "ratios") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "e".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501

WITH "counts" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "n" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".event_date), "avg" AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(n)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "mean_n" FROM "counts" WHERE event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND event_date < '2019-12-01') SELECT "c".n, "avg".mean_n, CASE WHEN "c".n > "avg".mean_n THEN 'more' WHEN "c".n < "avg".mean_n THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END FROM "counts" AS "c" CROSS JOIN "avg" WHERE "c".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' LIMIT 501

WITH "departments" AS (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'), "department_majors" AS (SELECT "m".department, "m".major_id, "m".major_name FROM "major" AS "m" INNER JOIN "departments" AS "d" ON "d".department = "m".department), "totals" AS (SELECT "dm".department, COUNT(DISTINCT "dm".major_id) AS "major_count", COUNT("mem".member_id) AS "member_count" FROM "department_majors" AS "dm" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mem" ON "mem".link_to_major = "dm".major_id GROUP BY "dm".department), "output_majors" AS (SELECT "dm".department, "dm".major_id, "dm".major_name FROM "department_majors" AS "dm" INNER JOIN "major" AS "college_major" ON "college_major".major_id = "dm".major_id WHERE "college_major".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') SELECT "t".department, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "om".major_name, ', ' ORDER BY "om".major_name ASC) AS "majors_offered", STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "mem".member_id IS NOT NULL THEN "om".major_name END, ', ' ORDER BY CASE WHEN "mem".member_id IS NOT NULL THEN "om".major_name END ASC) AS "majors_held_by_members", ROUND("t".member_count::NUMERIC / NULLIF("t".major_count, 0), 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "totals" AS "t" INNER JOIN "output_majors" AS "om" ON "om".department = "t".department LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mem" ON "mem".link_to_major = "om".major_id GROUP BY "t".department, "t".major_count, "t".member_count ORDER BY "t".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT event_type, SUM(attendee_count) AS "members_attended", SUM(event_budget) AS "total_budgeted_dollars" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".type AS "event_type", COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count", 0::BIGINT AS "event_budget" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".type UNION ALL SELECT "e".event_id, "e".type AS "event_type", 0::BIGINT AS "attendee_count", COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0)::BIGINT AS "event_budget" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".type) AS "u" GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY event_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m"."department", COALESCE(SUM("i"."amount"), 0) AS "total dues" FROM "major" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mb" ON "mb"."link_to_major" = "m"."major_id" AND "mb"."position" = 'Member' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "link_to_member" FROM "attendance") AS "a" ON "a"."link_to_member" = "mb"."member_id" LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i"."link_to_member" = "mb"."member_id" AND "i"."source" = 'Dues' WHERE "m"."college" = 'College of Engineering' AND ("mb"."member_id" IS NULL OR "a"."link_to_member" IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY "m"."department" ORDER BY "m"."department" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount - "b".spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget WHERE "e".cost > 50 GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m2".major_name) AS "major_count" FROM "major" AS "m1" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "m1".major_id INNER JOIN "major" AS "m2" ON "m2".college = "m1".college LEFT JOIN "member" AS "enrolled" ON "enrolled".link_to_major = "m2".major_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "m".last_name = 'Hewitt' AND "enrolled".member_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 2) AS "average_attendees_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT "mj".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "m".member_id) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "mj" ON "mj".major_id = "m".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "mj".major_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "m".member_id) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m2".member_id) AS "cnt" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "m2".member_id = "a2".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "mj2" ON "mj2".major_id = "m2".link_to_major WHERE "e2".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "mj2".major_name) AS "major_counts") ORDER BY "mj".major_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m"."major_id" IS NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "major" AS "maj" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "link_to_major" AS "major_id" FROM "member" WHERE "link_to_major" IS NOT NULL) AS "m" ON "maj"."major_id" = "m"."major_id" LIMIT 501

SELECT member_group, ROUND(AVG(event_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_events_attended" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN "m".position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other student' END AS "member_group", "m".member_id, COUNT("a".link_to_event) AS "event_count" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) AS "per_member" GROUP BY member_group ORDER BY member_group ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "e".expense_description = 'Water, chips, cookies' THEN 'Water' WHEN "e".expense_description = 'Water, Cookies' THEN 'Water' ELSE "e".expense_description END) AS "count" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "b" GROUP BY "b".link_to_event HAVING BOOL_OR("b".amount - "b".spent < 0)) AS "oe" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "oe".link_to_event INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM("ex".cost) FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "ex" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "ex".expense_description ILIKE '%water%'), 0)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member), 2) AS "amount_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "major".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 'major in the College of Humanities and Social Sciences' ELSE 'do not major in the College of Humanities and Social Sciences' END AS "group", COUNT(*) AS "member_count" FROM "member" LEFT JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN "major".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 'major in the College of Humanities and Social Sciences' ELSE 'do not major in the College of Humanities and Social Sciences' END ORDER BY "group" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chip%' AND "b".amount = (SELECT MAX("b2".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b2" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x2" ON "x2".link_to_budget = "b2".budget_id WHERE "x2".expense_description ILIKE '%chip%') LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_date" AS (SELECT MAX("e".expense_date) AS "expense_date" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President') SELECT "latest_date".expense_date AS "expense_date", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "latest_date" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".expense_date = "latest_date".expense_date GROUP BY "latest_date".expense_date ORDER BY "latest_date".expense_date DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "major_counts" AS (SELECT "ma".college, COUNT(DISTINCT "ma".major_id) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "me" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "me".link_to_major = "ma".major_id GROUP BY "ma".college), "ranked" AS (SELECT college, number_of_majors, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY number_of_majors DESC) AS "rank_position" FROM "major_counts") SELECT college, number_of_majors FROM "ranked" WHERE rank_position = 1 ORDER BY college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "ex".expense_description) AS "number_of_different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "ex" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".amount > 40 AND "e".location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-10-01' AND "x".expense_description = 'Pizza' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "event_spent" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "per_event" LIMIT 501

WITH "event_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_budget", COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "total_spending", COUNT("x".expense_id) AS "purchase_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name) SELECT event_name FROM "event_totals" WHERE total_spending <= total_budget ORDER BY purchase_count DESC, event_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "type_totals" AS (SELECT "e"."type", COUNT(DISTINCT ("e"."event_id", "a"."link_to_member")) AS "members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a"."link_to_event" = "e"."event_id" WHERE "e"."event_date" >= '2019-09-01' AND "e"."event_date" < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e"."type") SELECT "type", members_attended FROM "type_totals" WHERE members_attended = (SELECT MAX(members_attended) FROM "type_totals") LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description, COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY record_count DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item_name", "b".category AS "budget_category", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "v" ON "b".link_to_event = "v".event_id WHERE "v".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "e".approved = 'true' AND "v".event_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "v".event_date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY "e".expense_description, "b".category ORDER BY "b".category ASC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, SUM("b".amount) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".event_date ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "purchase_count" FROM "expense" INNER JOIN "member" ON "expense".link_to_member = "member".member_id WHERE "member".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "member".last_name = 'Harrison' GROUP BY expense_description LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "major".major_name) AS "different_majors" FROM "member" INNER JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id WHERE "major".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "pub" ON "s".publisher_id = "pub".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "hp".power_id = "sp".id WHERE "pub".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest_rnp" AS (SELECT MAX(CAST("rnp" AS INTEGER)) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$'), "candidates" AS (SELECT "l"."T-BIL", "l"."date", "l"."id", "p"."sex", "p"."birthday" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "l"."id" CROSS JOIN "strongest_rnp" AS "s" WHERE "l"."rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l"."rnp" AS INTEGER) = "s".max_rnp AND "l"."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "T-BIL", "date", "id", "sex", "birthday" FROM "candidates" WHERE "T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM "candidates") LIMIT 501

SELECT sex, ROUND(AVG(test_date_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, COUNT("l".date) AS "test_date_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex) AS "patient_counts" GROUP BY sex ORDER BY sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna, CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) AS "dna_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna <> 'negative'), "maxima" AS (SELECT id, MAX(dna_level) AS "max_level" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY id) SELECT "e".id, "e".date, "e".dna FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "maxima" AS "m" ON "e".id = "m".id AND "e".dna_level = "m".max_level ORDER BY "e".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')), "settings" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN '+' ELSE '-' END AS "setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-')) SELECT setting, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "settings" GROUP BY setting ORDER BY setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "h".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "h" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "h".id INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "h".id WHERE "h".hct IS NOT NULL AND ("h".hct <= 29 OR "h".hct >= 52) AND "r".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "r".rnp <> 'negative' AND CAST("r".rnp AS INTEGER) > 16 LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".diagnosis ~ '^[[:space:]]*(RA[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*SJS|SJS[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*RA)[[:space:]]*$'), "status" AS (SELECT "e".id, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "has_normal" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".id) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_normal = 1) AS "patients_with_normal_platelet", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_normal = 0) AS "patients_never_with_normal_platelet" FROM "status" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND ("e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' OR "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%systemic lupus erythematosus%') AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) > 64) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::BIGINT > 32 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INTEGER) AS "youngest_age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 64 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e"."Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "e"."Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "e".thrombosis IS NOT NULL AND "e".thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "diagnosis" ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE "thrombosis" = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("first_exam".exam_date - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MIN("Examination Date") AS "exam_date" FROM "examination" WHERE id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id) AS "first_exam" ON "first_exam".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id AS "patient_id", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "completed_age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "count_difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_creatinine_out_of_range", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "p".admission, "p".id, "l"."T-CHO", MAX("l"."T-CHO") OVER (PARTITION BY "p".admission) AS "highest" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL) SELECT admission, id, "T-CHO" FROM "ranked" WHERE "T-CHO" = highest ORDER BY CASE admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC, id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT id, rnp AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "laboratory" WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM "patient" WHERE "First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01') AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative' AND CAST(rnp AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("l2".rnp AS INTEGER)) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id IN (SELECT id FROM "patient" WHERE "First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01') AND "l2".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l2".rnp <> 'negative') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("l".rf = '-' OR "l".rf = '+-') AND ("e".kct <> '+' OR "e".kct IS NULL) AND ("e".rvvt <> '+' OR "e".rvvt IS NULL) AND ("e".lac <> '+' OR "e".lac IS NULL) LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_lab" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_scl70" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, sc170 FROM "laboratory" WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "latest_lab" AS "ll" ON "ll".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "latest_scl70" AS "ls" ON "ls".id = "p".id WHERE "ll".latest_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND ("ls".sc170 = 'negative' OR "ls".sc170 = '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM "laboratory" WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ssa IS NOT NULL AND ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) AND id IN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER)) AS "highest_anti_rnp_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".cre < 1.5 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 1 WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT id, date, rnp, CAST(rnp AS INTEGER) AS "rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative') SELECT id, date, rnp FROM "eligible" WHERE rnp_value = (SELECT MAX(rnp_value) FROM "eligible") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "eligible_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR BTRIM("p".sex) = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "highest_ever_rnp_level" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "a" ON "a".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "a".hgb < 10 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex HAVING MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(rnp::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative') ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id AND "l2"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp <> '0' AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('16', '64', '256')), "normal_gpt" AS (SELECT id, MAX(gpt) AS "max_gpt" FROM "laboratory" WHERE gpt < 60 GROUP BY id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "p".birthday, "n".max_gpt, "p".id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "n".max_gpt DESC, "p".id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "normal_gpt" AS "n" ON "n".id = "e".id INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id) SELECT birthday FROM "ranked" WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY max_gpt DESC, id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT FLOOR(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age("l".date, "p".birthday))) AS "age", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' AND "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_patients" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "patient_results" AS (SELECT "ep".id, "ep".care_setting, BOOL_OR("l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 4) AS "has_elevated_result" FROM "eligible_patients" AS "ep" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "ep".id GROUP BY "ep".id, "ep".care_setting) SELECT care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_result) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_result_at_least_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_elevated_result) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "patient_results" GROUP BY care_setting ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, MAX("l".dna) AS "highest_anti_dna_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+$' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".diagnosis ORDER BY MAX("l".dna::NUMERIC) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH "latest_igg" AS (SELECT id, igg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC NULLS LAST) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL), "patient_status" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN "p".admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "setting", "l".igg FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "latest_igg" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id AND "l".rn = 1 WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(', '-')) SELECT setting, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE igg > 900 AND igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient_status" GROUP BY setting ORDER BY CASE setting WHEN 'admitted to the hospital' THEN 1 WHEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC NULLS LAST) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l"), "counts" AS (SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM "latest" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rn = 1 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 32 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(n) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'F'), 0) - COALESCE(MAX(n) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'M'), 0) AS "female_minus_male" FROM "counts" LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp, "l".cpk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F') SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ranked" WHERE rn = 1 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative' AND CAST(rnp AS INTEGER) > 64 AND cpk < 250 LIMIT 501
