SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' ORDER BY ("p"."First Date" - "p".birthday) DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5), "grouped" AS (SELECT "p".admission, "p".birthday, "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "qualifying_patients" AS "q" ON "q".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "ages" AS (SELECT admission, id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE '2026-10-09') - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM birthday) - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(DATE '2026-10-09', 'MMDD') < TO_CHAR(birthday, 'MMDD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "completed_age" FROM "grouped") SELECT admission, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(completed_age)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "ages" GROUP BY admission ORDER BY admission DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SjS%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SjS susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".id) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "sm".id FROM "laboratory" AS "sm" WHERE "sm".sm IN ('negative', '0')) AS "q" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".thrombosis = 0) AS "no_thrombosis" ON "no_thrombosis".id = "q".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "laboratory" AS "p" WHERE "p"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "proteinuria" ON "proteinuria".id = "q".id LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l_rbc" ON "l_rbc".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l_rnp" ON "l_rnp".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("l_rbc".rbc <= 3.5 OR "l_rbc".rbc >= 6.0) AND "l_rnp".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l_rnp".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l_rnp".rnp <> '0' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative' AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER >= 64) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday) < INTERVAL '70 years' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 15 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday) - CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "l".date), EXTRACT(DAY FROM "l".date)) < (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "p".birthday), EXTRACT(DAY FROM "p".birthday)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END < 50 AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id HAVING BOOL_OR("b".bond_type = '-')) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-' GROUP BY molecule_id) AS "bond_counts" INNER JOIN "molecule" USING (molecule_id) WHERE label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' AND "a".element IN ('i', 's') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_without_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '#') AS "triple_molecules" ON "triple_molecules".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "atom" WHERE element IN ('p', 'br')) AS "element_molecules" ON "element_molecules".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage_chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "hydrogen_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_bond_status" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, CASE WHEN COUNT("b".bond_id) > 0 AND BOOL_AND("b".bond_type = '-') THEN 'all_single' ELSE 'other' END AS "bond_group" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label) SELECT bond_group, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule_bond_status" GROUP BY bond_group ORDER BY CASE bond_group WHEN 'all_single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '=' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '+'), 2) AS "percentage_of_all_plus_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) = (SELECT MAX("x".n) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ax".atom_id) AS "n" FROM "atom" AS "ax" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "mx" ON "mx".molecule_id = "ax".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "cx" ON "cx".atom_id = "ax".atom_id WHERE "mx".label = '+' GROUP BY "ax".element) AS "x") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT("b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond type", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=', '#') GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 WHEN "a2".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id END) AS "count_atoms_bonded_to_chlorine" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' OR "a2".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "neighbor".atom_id) FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "sulfur" ON "sulfur".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "sulfur".element = 's' INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "sulfur".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "sulfur".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "neighbor" ON "neighbor".atom_id = CASE WHEN "c".atom_id = "sulfur".atom_id THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "other_a" ON "other_a".element = "a".element AND "other_a".molecule_id <> "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "other_a".atom_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "n".molecule_id) FROM "atom" AS "n" WHERE "n".element = 'n' AND "n".molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT "n2".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "n2" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "n2".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "n2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "n2".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c"."atom_id2") FROM "atom" AS "chlorine" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "chlorine"."atom_id" = "c"."atom_id" WHERE "chlorine"."element" = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN "m".molecule_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id), 2) AS "carcinogenic_percent", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN "m".molecule_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id), 2) AS "non_carcinogenic_percent" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' LIMIT 501

WITH "rare_elements" AS (SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) = 1), "qualifying_atoms" AS (SELECT "a".molecule_id, "a".atom_id FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "rare_elements" AS "r" ON "r".element = "a".element), "qualifying_molecules" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "qa".molecule_id FROM "qualifying_atoms" AS "qa" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "qa".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+') SELECT "qm".molecule_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "qualifying_molecules" AS "qm" INNER JOIN "qualifying_atoms" AS "qa" ON "qa".molecule_id = "qm".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "qa".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "qa".atom_id GROUP BY "qm".molecule_id ORDER BY "qm".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS "carbon_atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atom_count" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bond_count" FROM "bond" GROUP BY molecule_id), "carbon_touching" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".molecule_id) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("ct".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) DESC, "ac".atom_count DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank", "m".molecule_id, "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", "ac".atom_count, COALESCE("bc".bond_count, 0) AS "bond_count", "ac".carbon_atom_count, "ac".chlorine_atom_count, COALESCE("ct".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bond_count, 0) AS "multiple_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "carbon_touching" AS "ct" ON "ct".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".carbon_atom_count > 0 ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "yt" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "h".molecule_id = "yt".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "h".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "h".atom_id WHERE "yt".element = 'y' AND "h".element = 'h' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "per_atom" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element AS "element", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a2".element ORDER BY "a2".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT ("c".atom_id, "c".atom_id2)) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY bond_count DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' AND "a".atom_id NOT IN (SELECT "c2".atom_id FROM "connected" AS "c2" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b2" ON "b2".bond_id = "c2".bond_id WHERE "b2".bond_type IN ('=', '#') UNION ALL SELECT "c2".atom_id2 FROM "connected" AS "c2" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b2" ON "b2".bond_id = "c2".bond_id WHERE "b2".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
